reason: The proposed adversarial reweighting changes the training objective to improve calibration under distribution shift. Experiments use CIFAR-10H, PACS, and CivilComments classifiers with four-expert MoEs; calibration/accuracy is measured, not LLM runtime, serving, memory, or throughput. It addresses prediction reliability rather than inference efficiency.
title: Toward Calibrated Mixture-of-Experts Under Distribution Shift
